IAS Officer Accused of Abusing Woman JKAS Officer in J&K Meeting

A senior IAS officer, Kumar Rajiv Ranjan, allegedly used abusive language towards a woman JKAS officer, Binish Wani, during a review meeting at the Srinagar secretariat. The incident, which reportedly included the officer saying "I am your boss, stupid," was captured on video and has caused a stir in administrative circles. The IAS officer has denied the video's authenticity. Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has written to the Chief Secretary regarding the alleged verbal abuse.
